subject: Billing cutover and VAT evidence request for Solara Biotech acquisition
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@solarabiotech.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@solara-legal.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Solara acquisition — billing entity & VAT evidence needed

Hi Priyom,

Quick note from Solara — we closed our acquisition last week and are consolidating procurement under Solara Biotech Holdings, S.L. (Spain). We need Redwood to route invoices to the new legal entity and to confirm VAT handling for EU transactions (reverse charge vs. VAT registration).

What we need from Redwood to complete our AP cutover:
- Updated invoice recipient and remit-to address (legal name + tax id)
- Confirmation whether Redwood will issue invoices with VAT or on a reverse-charge basis to a Spanish VAT-registered buyer
- A short list of supporting docs we should upload to your portal (e.g., supplier W-9 / local equivalent, VAT certificate, signed M&A notification)
- Date you can start issuing invoices under the new entity (we prefer 2028-08-01)

I'll loop in Carlos from our legal team for the tax docs. Attaching our internal acquisition memo for context.

Thanks —
Elena Ortiz
Head of Procurement
Solara Biotech
Attachments: Solara_acq_memo.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@solarabiotech.com>
Cc: Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@solara-legal.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Solara acquisition — billing entity & VAT evidence needed

Hi Elena — congrats on the close, and thanks for the clear list. We can support the cutover but will need a couple of things from our side:

1) Finance will need Solara's Spanish VAT registration certificate (PDF), and the legal entity's full registered address and tax id.
2) Our billing ops team requires a signed confirmation that Redwood can invoice Solara Biotech Holdings, S.L. for all existing subscriptions (a short redirect form — I can send a template).
3) If you want invoices without VAT (reverse charge), we will need the VAT number and the certificate to validate the EU reverse-charge. Otherwise we will continue to apply VAT where applicable.

Marissa / Monica — can you confirm the internal steps and how quickly we can implement an invoice rename + remit-to change once we have the docs? Also including the invoice template and the internal playbook for entity transfers.

Elena — I'll send the redirect form and our invoice template in a follow-up. Targeting 2028-08-01 as long as we get the docs by 2028-07-25.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0134
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@solarabiotech.com>, Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@solara-legal.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Solara acquisition — billing entity & VAT evidence needed

Priyom / Monica — quick ops plan:

- Step 1 (validation): We validate the Spanish VAT certificate against VIES and confirm tax id format.
- Step 2 (docs): We need the signed redirect form plus the PDF VAT cert. If Solara is non-US, W-9 not required; Carlos, if you can confirm local tax doc name we will accept that.
- Step 3 (system change): Once validated, we update the "bill_to" and "remit_to" fields in our billing system. This will change invoice header, billing contact, and remit instructions.
- Step 4 (in-flight charges): Any invoices already issued for periods before the cutover date will remain under the old entity; new invoices dated >= cutover date will reflect the new legal name.
- Step 5 (bank details): If you want wire info updated on the invoices, provide beneficiary name + IBAN/SWIFT and we'll include it on subsequent statements.

Timeline: If we have all docs by 2028-07-25, ops can punt the change to the week of 2028-07-29 and cutover on 2028-08-01. Otherwise we'll need a later date.

Attachments (internal): entity_transfer_playbook.xlsx, invoice-template-redwood.pdf

Monica — please prepare the draft redirect form and the checklist we send to EU buyers for reverse-charge validation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@solarabiotech.com>, Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@solara-legal.com>

Hi Elena / Carlos —

Thanks for the quick replies. Carlos — when you have the VAT cert and a signed redirect, please upload them to the Drive link below or reply directly to this thread. We'll treat the docs as confidential.

Next steps checklist for Solara (summary):
- Upload Spanish VAT certificate (PDF) or provide VIES link to validate
- Complete & sign Redwood Invoice Redirect form (I attached a draft below)
- Confirm preferred invoice start date (requested 2028-08-01) and whether you want bank beneficiary updated on invoices

We have attached the draft redirect form and our invoice template for your review. Once Marissa validates the VAT number we will schedule the system update.
